note: REFINEMENT from the #2329 q35_ladder_decay efficiency reconciler (binding ruling, round 1) — read this before implementing the branch-coverage check. The reconciler VERIFIED the arithmetic that motivated this task (permitted-branch upper bound ~10.8 GPU-h against a booked 6, with an extreme triple-tail conjunction near ~14.5) but ruled it a DISCLOSURE requirement rather than a blocker, and it OVERTURNED half the original finding. Two consequences for the check's design: (1) The check must NOT compare the branch upper bound against a STATIC fence. The reconciler found the fence half of the finding fails verification because this plan re-derives every fence to >=2x the pilot-extrapolated wall, so the fence in force at a near-threshold pilot (~14h) already exceeds the branch bound (~10.8), while at a baseline pilot the reachable branch (~8.4h) sits under the 9-10h fence. A check that reads the fence as a fixed number will emit false FAILs on exactly the plans that are sizing correctly. Compare against the fence AS RE-DERIVED under the same branch the bound is computed for. (2) The check must NOT push toward a budget-derived abort threshold. The reconciler explicitly called that remedy anti-efficient: binding the booking would imply aborting at ~1.3x basis, tighter than the house-standard >2x pilot abort in plan-compute-sizing.md § Per-cell fit phases, and house doctrine deliberately sizes the FENCE to worst case and the BOOKING to a p90-style projection plus reserve ('p90, NEVER the mean/max'). So the right verdict shape is WARN-with-disclosure — require the plan to STATE the permitted-branch upper bound next to the booked estimate (e.g. 'booked 6 = 4.6 base + 1.4 reserve; permitted-branch upper bound ~7.1 G2-max-no-regen / ~10.8 G2-max-plus-broad-regen; still < 20 cheap band') and, where a regeneration contingency is named, require either a bounded regen aggregate or an explicit statement that the named reserve does not cover its broad form. A FAIL is appropriate only when the bound crosses a ROUTING or APPROVAL rail (e.g. out of the cheap band), which it did not here. The compound wall-cell half of this task is unaffected and still stands as filed.
